verdict.rationale: The Gemini API documents its own asynchronous execution: the quickstart lists "background execution", the Batch API processes requests asynchronously, managed agents can take delegated tasks (public preview), and webhooks report completed long-running operations. However, there is no evidence of setting up recurring or scheduled automations or event-triggered workflows that run on their own; what is shown is one-off async jobs, not ongoing automations. missing for 10: recurring schedules or triggers for automations, detailed docs on background or managed-agent execution, GA status for managed agents and webhooks, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: function calling, agents, and background execution
The Gemini Batch API is designed to process large volumes of requests asynchronously at 50% of the standard cost.
Your coding agent can use it to generate text and media, analyze files, and delegate tasks to [Gemini managed agents].
Webhooks allow the Gemini API to push real-time notifications to your server when asynchronous or Long-Running Operations (LROs) complete.
